```{r assignment 6 start-up}

con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

```


# Task 1
```{r task 1}

con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")

host_counts <- listings |> dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listings")
listings_hc <- listings |> dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

A1 <- host_counts |> dplyr::filter(host_listings >= 10) |> nrow()
A1

A2 <- listings_hc |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarize(pct = 100 * mean(host_listings >= 10))
A2

```


# Task 2
```{r task 2}

value_homes <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt",
                accommodates >= 4,
                number_of_reviews >= 10,
                review_scores_rating >= 4.8) |>
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates)

nbhd_ppp <- value_homes |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarize(median_ppp = median(price_per_person),
                   n_listings = dplyr::n(),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(n_listings >= 20)

A3 <- nbhd_ppp |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_ppp) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
A3

```

# Task 3
```{r task 3}

city_room_medians <- listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(dplyr::across(c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
                                 \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
                   .groups = "drop")
city_room_medians

A4 <- city_room_medians |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities", room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  dplyr::pull(estimated_revenue_l365d)
A4

```


# Task 4
```{r task 4}

top_earners <- listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(top10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

top_share <- top_earners |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(pct_top10 = 100 * sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top10], na.rm = TRUE) /
                                     sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE))
top_share

A5 <- top_share |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::pull(pct_top10)
A5
```


# Task 5
```{r task 5}

oct_avail <- availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10")

entire_oct <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(oct_avail, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month)

taken_share <- entire_oct |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(share_taken = mean(mostly_taken),
                   n_homes = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::arrange(share_taken)
taken_share

A6_A7 <- taken_share |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
A6_A7

```

# Task 6
```{r task 6}

reviews_city <- reviews |>
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07", month <= "2026-06") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::select(listings, id, city), by = "id")

monthly_reviews <- reviews_city |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop")

twin <- monthly_reviews |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))
twin

A8 <- twin |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) |> dplyr::pull(month)
A8

A9 <- max(twin$total_reviews) / min(twin$total_reviews)
A9
```

# Task 7
```{r task 7}

superhost_medians <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt",
                !is.na(host_is_superhost)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarize(median_price     = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                   median_rating    = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
                   median_rev_month = median(reviews_per_month, na.rm = TRUE),
                   median_revenue   = median(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_homes          = dplyr::n(),
                   .groups = "drop")
superhost_medians

premiums <- superhost_medians |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(premium = median_price[host_is_superhost == "t"] -
                             median_price[host_is_superhost == "f"])
premiums

```

no_avail_by_city
